same seven nodes, tb, rms fan of four. --check exit 1: no obstacle-safe route for rms -> oob, rms -> nvos, rms -> bmc_c, rms -> nmxc (a leaf box cannot carry four out-ports past the bus). Recorded as v1-a2-check.

probes.label: probe-p1-tb-nolabels
probes.purpose: capability preflight: does the seven-node three-world topology route without labels? It does (extent 73x23, 1 trunk junction, 4 bridges, 1 shared run), which proved the routing failures in v1-a2 came from label placement, not from the trunk shape.

probes.label: v1-a3-check
probes.purpose: measured yield evidence: the five-node OOB view with the rank-spanning controller edge rms -> Compute BMC ('Redfish/HTTPS'). --check exit 1: 'no obstacle-safe route for rms -> bmc_c'; with the target moved to the power shelf (label probe-p3-lr-api-to-pwr) it fails again. Two targets, two failures, so the off-rack controller edge cannot cross the OOB bus in this view and its API semantics moved to v2. The spec file is restored after being overwritten in place during iteration; its --check output is the recorded stdout/stderr under this label.

probes.label: probe-p3-lr-api-to-pwr
probes.purpose: second target for the same yield test; --check exit 1, no obstacle-safe route for rms -> pwr.

probes.label: probe-p4-hub-minimal
probes.purpose: capability preflight for the one-split trunk: a five-node minimal spec with one trunk, two branches, one label-free graph. --check exit 0 but 'warning: two edges share 2 cell(s), including ports': the hub's junction cell is shared by construction, so a single-split trunk can never clear the shared-run warning with this binary.

probes.label: probe-p5-v3-tb-nolabels
probes.purpose: capability preflight for the compute chain: the same six nodes and five edges with no labels route in tb (extent 31x36, crossings 0), so only the label gutters blocked the fan.

probes.label: probe-v1-draw1
probes.purpose: diagnostic single frame at the pinned target size, used to confirm the shipped v1 drawing and to locate the shared junction cell.
